article.title: At the Hotel: Luggage Storage and Late Checkout

paragraphs.en: I arrived at my hotel in Tokyo at ten in the morning. Check-in begins at three in the afternoon, so my room is not ready yet. I have a small suitcase and a backpack. I want to visit a museum before checking in, but carrying both bags would be uncomfortable. At the front desk, I smile and say, 'Good morning. I have a reservation for tonight. Could you keep my luggage until check-in?' The receptionist asks for my name and confirms my booking. She explains where the bags will be stored and gives me a claim ticket.
paragraphs.zh: 我上午十點抵達東京飯店，但下午三點才能入住。我帶著行李箱和背包，想先去博物館，因此詢問櫃檯能否寄放行李。接待員確認訂房後說明保管位置，並給我領取憑證。
paragraphs.ja: 午前十時に東京のホテルに到着しましたが、チェックインは午後三時です。観光の前に荷物を預けたいので、フロントで予約を確認してもらい、預かり票を受け取ります。

paragraphs.en: Before leaving, I ask whether luggage storage is free and when I must collect my bags. Some hotels offer this service without charge, while others have restrictions. I do not assume that every hotel follows the same policy. The receptionist tells me to keep the claim ticket because I will need it when I return. I also ask whether I can leave valuable items inside my suitcase. She recommends keeping my passport, wallet, and electronics with me. I put these important things in my backpack and take a photograph of the claim ticket as a backup.
paragraphs.zh: 離開前我確認寄放是否免費、何時須領回，以及能否放貴重物品。各飯店規定不同。接待員提醒我保存領取憑證，並建議護照、錢包與電子產品隨身攜帶。我把重要物品放入背包，另外拍下憑證備份。
paragraphs.ja: 預かり料金や受取時間、貴重品の扱いを確認します。ホテルによって規則は異なります。パスポートや財布は自分で持ち、預かり票の写真も撮っておきます。

paragraphs.en: The next morning, I want to sleep a little longer. Normal checkout is at eleven, but my train leaves in the afternoon. I call the front desk and ask, 'Is late checkout available today?' The receptionist says it depends on room availability. She offers an extra hour for a fee. I ask, 'How much does it cost, and what time would I need to leave?' After hearing the price, I decide that the extra hour is useful. I confirm the new checkout time and ask whether the charge will appear on my final bill.
paragraphs.zh: 隔天早上我想多睡一下，正常退房是十一點，但火車下午才出發。我打電話詢問能否延後退房。接待員說要看房況，並提出付費延長一小時。我確認價格、新退房時間，以及費用是否列在最後帳單。
paragraphs.ja: 翌朝、レイトチェックアウトが可能か電話で尋ねます。空室状況によっては追加料金で一時間延長できます。料金、新しい退室時刻、精算方法を確認します。

paragraphs.en: At checkout, I return the room key and review the bill. I check the room rate and the late checkout fee before paying. I thank the staff and ask whether they can keep my suitcase for two more hours. They agree, so I collect it before going to the station. Today I practiced polite questions that are useful at many hotels: 'Could you keep my luggage?' 'Is there a fee?' and 'Is late checkout available?' Asking clearly helps me plan my day without misunderstandings. Hotel policies vary, so I always confirm the details directly with the staff.
paragraphs.zh: 退房時我交還房卡、檢查房價及延後退房費用。付款後，我再問能否寄放行李兩小時，並在前往車站前取回。今天練習了詢問寄放、費用及延後退房的禮貌句型。飯店規定不同，應直接確認。
paragraphs.ja: チェックアウト時に請求書を確認し、鍵を返します。その後二時間だけ荷物を預け、駅へ向かう前に受け取ります。料金や時間はホテルに直接確認することが大切です。
